Historical v1 evidence covers analysis only; it does not establish reference-location coverage.

Conditional independent fresh-process samples within each job under randomized balanced execution order. No pooling across jobs, hosts, builds, or physical shards: each workload series of a logical job comes from exactly one physical runner. Reused a baselines make within-pair comparisons dependent. Bounds are one-sided marginal 95% bounds, not simultaneous or familywise claims. All upper bounds passing is an intersection-union criterion, conditional on sampling assumptions. This estimates typical median process change, not p95, tails, or editor latency.

Exact residual (candidate-baseline-active_allowance)/max(baseline,1). Ties are retained. Upper <= 0 passes; lower > 0 is regression; otherwise inconclusive. Median bounds are conservative for atoms/ties. Exactly 105 pairs; no adaptive stopping or retries.

Unchanged authoritative Ir floor 2%; cache ceil 3%, minimum 3. No learned allowances apply. Layout is diagnostic only, not assumed cost-equivalent.
